Overview.CaptionsLabel: Captions — show translated text in the on-screen overlay
Overview.VoiceCableHint: For OBS / Discord: install VB-CABLE (vb-audio.com/Cable), pick 'CABLE Input' as output here, then set OBS/Discord mic to 'CABLE Output'.
Overview.SessionHint: A DeepL Voice session opens when you start capture. Configure your API key and target language on the Settings tab.
Overview.FireTestHint: Pushes a fake German→English subtitle into the overlay. Useful for tuning styling without burning a live session.

Settings.TargetLangHint: Type to filter. Only DeepL-supported values are accepted.
Settings.ApiKeyHint: Key is stored locally under %AppData%\VoiceBuddy\settings.json. Transmitted only to the configured DeepL host.
Settings.AppLanguageHint: Switch language live — all labels update instantly.

Layout.PanelOpacityHint: Fills the entire overlay area behind the subtitle bubbles. Set opacity to 0 for a transparent overlay.
Layout.ClearAfterHint: Silence past 'new sentence' splits the current utterance into its own bubble. Silence past 'clear after' wipes the overlay entirely.
Layout.ObsCaptureMode: OBS capture mode (show overlay in window pickers)
Layout.ObsCaptureModeHint: Exposes the overlay to OBS as 'VoiceBuddy — Subtitles'. In OBS Window Capture, set Capture Method to 'Windows 10 (1903 and up)' to preserve transparency.
Layout.AnchoredModeHint: Anchored mode snaps the overlay to a screen anchor and applies offsets.
Layout.FreeformModeHint: Drag the unlocked overlay anywhere, including other screens.
Layout.DimensionHint: Width and height apply in both anchored and freeform modes.
